cases.label: computer use • allowlist rejects an unlisted app
notes: note: When an allowlist is set, an app not on it is rejected before disposition is even consulted.

cases.label: computer use • allowlist permits a listed app
notes: note: Allowlist matching is case-insensitive on the normalized app name, so 'Safari' matches a 'safari' entry.

cases.label: computer use • ambiguous click defaults stricter
notes: note: A click with no resolved role, label, or describe could do anything, so the classifier escalates navigate -> edit and balanced confirms rather than auto-running blind.

cases.label: computer use • Save with invitees is consequential
notes: note: The spec's calendar-save-with-invitees case: a generic Save commit becomes consequential when recipients are in play, so even trusted confirms it.

cases.label: computer use • cautious confirms even navigation
notes: note: Cautious asks before everything except reading, so even a plain navigate confirms.

cases.label: computer use • agent ceiling caps an autonomous policy
notes: note: The per-agent ceiling merges strictest-wins on top of the user policy: an autonomous policy that would auto-run everything is still forced to confirm a consequential action when the agent is capped at balanced.

cases.label: computer use • Cmd+Return is a submit chord
notes: note: Cmd+Return / Cmd+Enter is the conventional submit/send chord, so it escalates the press_key edit baseline to consequential and balanced confirms.

cases.label: computer use • edit confirms under balanced
notes: note: Typing mutates reviewable state, so balanced asks first. Matches PR1's hardwired behaviour.

cases.label: computer use • navigate auto-runs under balanced
notes: note: A plain link click moves the viewport without committing a change, so balanced lets it run without a prompt.

cases.label: computer use • per-app override only tightens
notes: note: Global trusted would auto-run an edit, but the Mail per-app override (cautious) makes it confirm. Per-app overrides can only add caution, never remove it.

cases.label: computer use • read auto-runs under balanced
notes: note: Perception never mutates anything, so a read effect always auto-runs regardless of preset. The floor of the whole gate.

cases.label: computer use • read-only denies edits
notes: note: The read-only preset explores and navigates freely but refuses any edit outright; the reason is fed back to the model.

cases.label: computer use • dialog 'Don't Save' escalates everywhere
notes: note: The universal dialog recipe applies to every app: a 'Don't Save' button discards work, so even under trusted it confirms.

cases.label: computer use • Safari 'Leave Site' escalates via recipe
notes: note: The app-agnostic vocabulary doesn't know 'Leave Site' (it would stay navigate); the Safari recipe adds it as a consequential signal so balanced confirms.

cases.label: computer use • Send button escalates to consequential
notes: note: A navigate-baseline click on a Send control crosses a trust boundary, so the classifier escalates navigate -> consequential and balanced confirms it.

cases.label: computer use • trusted auto-runs edits
notes: note: Trusted runs edits and only confirms consequential actions, so a benign field edit auto-runs.
